edits: Imported Unreal-Godot/UAL1_Standard.glb; kept its single 65-joint armature and the Mannequin mesh (13,743 triangles) and deleted the importer's bone-shape helper object
Kept 3 of the 43 clips and renamed them idle (Idle_Loop), walk (Walk_Loop), run (Jog_Fwd_Loop); deleted the other 40 actions

Replaced the source materials (M_Main orange, M_Joints purple) with four flat materials assigned per face by dominant joint weight: coat_navy #1f2a44 (pelvis, spine, clavicle, upperarm, lowerarm, thigh, unweighted), trousers_stone #a8a59a (calf), shoes_dark #2a2622 (foot, ball, toe), skin #c99a7a (head, neck, hands, fingers); the hex values were converted sRGB to linear for baseColorFactor
Decimate collapse from 13,743 to 11,385 triangles (#545 limit 11,500; the phone target is about 10k)
Rotated 180 degrees about Z so the character faces -Z, the glTF contract in apps/web/src/explorer/avatarGlb.ts
No textures; the clips keep their source keys (sampled at 24 fps) and stay in place (the non-_RM library ships root motion disabled)
generator: tools/blender/character/build_cc0_candidates.py under Blender 5.2.2 LTS (headless -b), glTF 2.0 exporter with export_animation_mode=ACTIONS, skins on, no cameras/lights
budget: phone tier: about 10k triangles target (shipped 11,385, the #545 ceiling), textures 0 bytes
